VAL-000005.grounding_summary: The Abarth 500C (Cabriolet) was officially launched in Israel in November 2010. It was sold with a 1.4L Turbo engine. While initially offered primarily with a robotic gearbox, a manual transmission was available by special order and later as a standard option across various trims. The first generation was marketed until late 2016, when the facelifted model arrived under the new name Abarth 595. The designation '500C' refers to the cabriolet body style rather than a specific trim level; actual marketed trims in Israel included Scorpione, Lusso, San Marino, Turismo, and Competizione.
